issues.title: Narration timing must come from LLM, not calculated from TTS
Manim only renders FIRST visual beat - multi-beat rendering not implemented
Recap narration only 5 seconds - LLM not generating full recap narration
Summary slide not displaying in player
Player displayItems fallback to narration_segments
issues.solution: Removed narration_segments fallback from displayItems in loadSlide().

issues.title: Duration field naming mismatch: v1.1 uses duration_seconds, code uses duration
issues.solution: Prompts use duration_seconds. Player and tts read duration_seconds with duration fallback.

issues.title: Section ID field mismatch: v1.1 uses section_id, code uses id
issues.solution: Prompts use section_id. Player and tts read section_id with id fallback.

issues.title: renderer_reasoning field missing
issues.solution: Added to prompts and passed through in player.js.

issues.title: Quiz section type not implemented
issues.solution: Implemented quiz section with: 1) Quiz rules in user_prompt.txt with question/choices/reveal_steps structure, 2) Quiz rendering in player.js with timed reveal steps, 3) Quiz CSS in index.html, 4) Quiz validation in llm_client.py validate_section_v2()

issues.title: Flashcard limit mismatch: v1.1 says 5, prompts say 3
issues.solution: Updated prompts to require 5 acronym-based flashcards (A-B-C-D-E).

issues.title: Visual beat purpose field naming: v1.1 uses 'purpose', code uses 'pedagogical_focus'
issues.solution: Prompts and visual_compiler use 'purpose'. Backward compatibility maintained.

issues.title: Visual beat missing duration_seconds field
issues.solution: Added to REQUIRED_VISUAL_BEAT_FIELDS in prompts and visual_compiler.py.

issues.title: Example section missing 5-step structure requirement
issues.solution: Added 5-step requirement to both prompts.

issues.title: Display fitness rules not enforced
issues.solution: Added to CRITICAL COMPLIANCE CHECKLIST in both prompts.

issues.title: Allowed gestures not constrained to v1.1 list
issues.solution: Added to CRITICAL COMPLIANCE CHECKLIST with allowed gestures list.

issues.title: Hard fail validation conditions not fully implemented
issues.solution: Created core/hard_fail_validator.py implementing all 6 conditions: 1) content_or_example_narration_below_minimum, 2) missing_visual_beats, 3) example_without_step_visualization, 4) formula_mentioned_but_not_visualized, 5) vague_visual_language_detected, 6) manim_section_without_scene_spec. Integrated into both pipeline functions.

issues.title: Traceability logging not implemented
issues.solution: Created core/traceability.py implementing: 1) generation_trace_required via TraceabilityLogger class, 2) render_prompts_logged via log_render_prompt(), 3) renderer_decisions_logged via log_renderer_decision(), 4) validation_results_logged via log_validation(). Integrated into both pipeline functions with init_traceability(), log_event(), log_hard_fail(), complete_trace().

issues.title: Avatar hidden behind content box in intro/memory modes
issues.description: In intro and memory section modes, the avatar appears behind the content box instead of in front. The content box needs lower z-index or avatar needs higher z-index for these modes.
issues.solution: Repositioned mode-center layout: avatar now on right side (right: 5%, height: 85%, z-index: 15), content-wrapper on left side (z-index: 10, padding-left: 5%, max-width: 65%). This gives the avatar clear visibility alongside content rather than hidden behind it.

issues.title: Text content not displaying when sharing/loading videos
issues.description: When accessing the player via shared URL, text content doesn't appear in content-box. May be race condition with displayItems population or typewriter initialization.
issues.solution: Root cause: segment-item and flashcard had very low default opacity (0.3-0.4) making them nearly invisible on dark background. Fixed by: 1) Increased base opacity to 0.7-0.75, 2) Added logic to mark first segment/flashcard as active on load for full visibility.

issues.title: Player initial load is very slow
issues.description: Player takes too long to load initially. Likely caused by preloading all audio files upfront instead of on-demand.
issues.solution: Implemented lazy video detection: 1) Only detect videos for current slide before showing UI, 2) Added detectVideosForSlide() with caching, 3) Background detection for remaining slides via detectRemainingVideosInBackground(), 4) Made loadSlide async to support on-demand detection.

issues.title: Avatar too small in video-primary mode and blank video at start
issues.description: When video plays, avatar is super tiny. Also blank video box appears before content loads. Avatar should be larger and content should appear instantly.
issues.solution: 1) Increased mode-content-video avatar size to 55% height and 35% max-width, 2) Added video-box opacity:0 by default with .video-ready class for opacity:1, 3) Added oncanplay event to add video-ready class when video is ready to play.

issues.title: LaTeX symbols in narration text cause TTS to read raw LaTeX
issues.description: Mathematical symbols like $h$ are passed to TTS as-is, so narration says 'dollar h dollar' instead of 'h'. Need to strip/convert LaTeX before sending to TTS.
issues.solution: Created core/latex_to_speech.py that converts LaTeX to speakable text (fractions, powers, Greek letters, operators). Integrated into tts/generate_audio.py to process narration before Narakeet API call.

issues.title: Add dev mode position/size stats overlay for layout debugging
issues.description: When toggling dev mode, display real-time position and size statistics for content wrapper and avatar so user can provide feedback on layout adjustments.
issues.solution: Added #dev-stats-overlay in player HTML showing layout mode, avatar position/size/aspect, content position/size, video box dimensions. Stats update every 500ms when visible. Toggle with D key or Dev button.

issues.title: Manim video sometimes cuts off at bottom
issues.description: Manim-rendered videos sometimes have content that extends below the visible area. Need dynamic vertical centering or adjustment based on video content.
issues.prior_attempt: Added object-fit: contain but video-box container height was still constrained by max-height: 60vh.

issues.title: Manim video cutoff - video-box height constraint too small
issues.description: Video-box had max-height: 60vh which was too small for taller Manim animations. Content at bottom of video was clipped.
issues.solution: Changed #stage from fixed height: 720px to min-height: 720px, height: auto, max-height: 90vh. This allows stage to expand for taller videos. Combined with max-height: 90vh on .mode-content-video #video-box for contained presentation.

issues.title: Text not displayed in content-video mode
issues.description: In mode-content-video, the content-box was hidden by default (max-width: 0, opacity: 0). Text only appeared when .text-visible class was manually added.
issues.solution: Modified player.js loadSlide() to synchronously detect rendered content (segments-list children, flashcards, quiz-containers) after DOM population. Adds .text-visible class when content exists, removes when empty. No setTimeout - runs immediately after content insertion.

issues.title: Avatar loses resolution/aspect ratio when resized
issues.description: When avatar is resized or repositioned, it appears stretched or loses quality. Aspect ratio should be maintained.
issues.solution: Added image-rendering: -webkit-optimize-contrast and image-rendering: crisp-edges to #avatar-canvas for better quality during canvas rendering.

issues.title: v1.2 Architecture Upgrade - 3-Pass LLM Pipeline
issues.description: Upgrade from 2-LLM architecture to 3-pass architecture with role-pure separation of concerns. Pass 0: Chunker (Gemini Flash), Pass 1: Director (Gemini Pro) for pedagogy only, Pass 2: Specialized renderers (Claude Sonnet for Manim/Remotion, Gemini Pro for Video).
issues.solution: Created: 1) core/llm_client_v12.py with 3-pass pipeline functions, 2) core/analytics.py for per-phase cost/time tracking, 3) core/pipeline_v12.py for production use, 4) 10 new prompt files in core/prompts/, 5) Backed up v1.1 to pipeline_v11.py and prompts/v1.1_backup/. Added validation to strip renderer fields from Director output and verify renderer output exists after Pass 2.

issues.title: v1.2 Hard Fail Validator Updates for 3-Pass Architecture
issues.description: Updated hard_fail_validator.py to support v1.2 output format: section-level scene specs instead of beat-level, embedded visual_beats inside narration_segments, and refined formula/vague detection.

issues_fixed.cause: Validator looked for beat-level manim_scene_spec, but v1.2 uses section-level
issues_fixed.fix: Updated check to look for section.manim_scene_spec first

issues_fixed.cause: Validator looked for separate visual_beats array, but v1.2 embeds them in narration_segments[].visual_beat
Director generating 109-120 word narrations instead of 150+
issues_fixed.fix: Updated director_system_v1.2.txt with HARD REQUIREMENTS section

issues_fixed.cause: Pattern matching too broad, triggering on 'equilibrium' in chemistry
issues_fixed.fix: Refined FORMULA_PATTERNS with word boundaries and stricter matches

issues_fixed.cause: Words like 'simple', 'like', 'general' flagged in valid contexts
issues_fixed.fix: Changed VAGUE_PHRASES to multi-word phrases only

issues.title: v1.2 Pipeline Test Playback Issues - Misdiagnosis
issues.description: Full pipeline test with use_remotion=False produced output in player/jobs/full_test_no_remotion/ but playback appeared broken. Initial diagnosis suggested major schema incompatibility, but investigation revealed:

initial_symptoms: Audio switching to female voice after slide 3
Player showing 15 slides instead of 7 sections

actual_findings.evidence: player.js lines 1059-1097 already convert sections[] to slides[], use section_id for audio paths
actual_findings.test_access_issue: Player was accessed loading OLD /player/assets/ folder instead of job-specific /player/jobs/full_test_no_remotion/
actual_findings.server_logs_confirm: Requests to /player/assets/section_1.mp3 (old location) instead of job folder

remaining_issues.visual_compiler_errors: 8 sections failed visual compilation - needs v1.2 beat format handling
remaining_issues.render_prompts_missing: No render_prompts.json output for WAN prompt traceability
remaining_issues.video_prompts_quality: Need to verify WAN prompts are specific enough (not vague)

sub_issues.title: Test run bypassed normal job routing
sub_issues.description: The test was run manually creating full_test_no_remotion folder, but player was loaded from wrong URL accessing old assets
sub_issues.fix: Access via proper job URL: /player/index.html?job=full_test_no_remotion or /jobs/full_test_no_remotion/

sub_issues.title: Visual Compiler fails on v1.2 beat format
sub_issues.description: Visual compiler expects v1.1 beat format but v1.2 uses {time, description} objects
sub_issues.fix: renderer_executor.py now detects v1.2 specs (manim_scene_spec, video_prompts) and bypasses Visual Compiler entirely. Visual Compiler only used as fallback for legacy v1.1 content.

sub_issues.title: render_prompts.json not generated in v1.2 pipeline
sub_issues.description: Traceability module not writing render_prompts.json for WAN prompt auditing
sub_issues.fix: Added save_render_prompts_json() to traceability.py, integrated into pipeline_v12.py at completion, added log_render_prompt() calls in renderer_executor.py for both manim and video prompts

sub_issues.title: WAN prompt quality validation not implemented
sub_issues.description: No automated check that Video (WAN) prompts are specific enough to generate quality videos
sub_issues.fix: Add heuristic checks for banned vague phrases in video prompts

issues.lesson_learned: Always verify player access URL and job routing before concluding schema incompatibility. The v1.2 schema IS compatible with existing player.
